description: A gleaming chrome espresso rig, all pressure gauges and hissing wands, that does most of Jitter's actual labour. A cup dispenser is bolted to one end of it, cups stacked nose to tail like shell casings. It's the cleanest object for a block in any direction and it knows it.

flags.vend_line: The dispenser thumps once and a paper cup drops out, seam-side up.

name: espresso rig
